items.title: Russian-appointed authorities report four deaths in Makiivka
items.summary: Local authorities in Russian-occupied Makiivka reported damage to residential buildings following an alleged Ukrainian drone attack. Russian emergency services said four bodies were recovered from the rubble. The account has not been independently verified.

items.title: Russia says Crimean Bridge restoration is progressing
items.summary: Russian Deputy Prime Minister Marat Khusnullin said restoration work on the Crimean Bridge was underway and that all project documentation had been prepared.

items.title: Meloni reportedly warns Zelensky over consequences of Libya incident
items.summary: According to a report attributed to La Repubblica, Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni warned Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky that the reported attack in Benghazi could make continued Italian assistance to Ukraine more difficult amid domestic opposition to military aid.
